rationale: The agent performed order-changing actions (modifying items and then canceling order #W1845024) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. The user asked to cancel only the office items if partial cancellation was possible, otherwise change the shipping address; instead, the agent proceeded to cancel an entire order without establishing whether partial cancellation was possible or identifying which items were office vs. hiking items. Authentication was minimal (name + ZIP lookup) and not clearly verified before acting. The provided refund amount and destination (PayPal) were stated without clear supporting tool outputs in the conversation, and the agent did not ensure the action aligned with the user’s intent. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
